cohort: 22 pregnant women with severe mitral stenosis who underwent BMV at Shahid Gangalal National Heart Centre (SGNHC) in Nepal between January 2003 and December 2007
finding: BMV during pregnancy was found to be feasible, safe, and effective, resulting in improved mitral valve area and reduced left atrial pressure, with excellent maternal and fetal outcomes.
mod_finding: 20 patients had a normal delivery while 2 underwent a caesarean section.
